articles.summary: Hafnia has collaborated with Masava Kemi and marine supply partner MOSCORD in the development and testing of a Bag-in-Box packaging solution for concentrated cleaning products used onboard vessels. The initiative explores an alternative to traditional chemical containers with the aim of improving storage efficiency, supporting easier handling and reducing the volume of packaging waste generated […]
articles.title: Hafnia Collaborates with Masava Kemi on Bag-in-Box Vessel Solution

articles.summary: Valdemar Witt Qvist, a Copenhagen Business School and Student Assistant in Hafnia’s Operations Team recently sailed on chemical tanker the Hafnia Azurite from Brofjorden, Sweden to Świnoujście, Poland.
